You link lab result lines to samples. Below is the sample register of one ship and the lines of a lab report. For each lab line, say which sample in the register it belongs to.

REGISTER (code | location | material | colour)
S-01 | Engine room, port bulkhead | Insulation wrap | grey fibrous
S-02 | Engine room, main engine exhaust | Pipe lagging | white
S-03 | Boiler room, boiler door | Gasket | black
S-04 | Accommodation deck 2, corridor | Ceiling panel | white-grey board
S-05 | Accommodation deck 2, cabin 214 | Floor covering | green vinyl
S-06 | Steering gear room | Flange gasket | grey
S-07 | Cargo hold 1 | Paint coating | red-brown
S-08 | Pump room | Pump packing | grey-white woven

LAB LINES (sample ID as written by the lab | description | result)
1. S02 | Exhaust pipe lagging, engine room | Asbestos not detected
2. s-03 | Boiler door gasket, black | Chrysotile 40%
3. S 04 | Ceiling panel, corridor deck 2 | Asbestos not detected
4. - | Pump packing, pump room, grey-white woven | Asbestos not detected

Reply with only a JSON object with one proposal per lab line, in order:
{"proposals":[{"n":1,"sample":"S-01","confidence":"high","reason":"one short sentence"}]}
"sample" is a register code, or null when no register sample is linked to that line. "confidence" is "high", "medium" or "low".

proposals.reason: S02 is S-02 and the exhaust pipe lagging matches.
s-03 is S-03 and the black boiler door gasket matches.
S 04 reads as S-04 and the corridor ceiling panel matches.
No sample ID on the lab line; the description alone is not enough to link.
